name: golviva
description: Football (soccer) match predictions, season projections and player valuations: win, draw and loss chances, likeliest scores and scorers and predicted line-ups for every match of 26 leagues, the Champions League, Europa League, Conference League and senior national teams; each club's title, top-four and relegation chances; Golviva's own estimated transfer values with the reasons behind them, scouting and rankings; plus live scores, match centres, league tables, stat leaders and transfer news. 18 read-only tools. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth, with Apple or Google), or send a personal API key from https://golviva.com/mcp as an Authorization Bearer header. Every account has a free daily allowance of tool calls. Predictions are model probabilities, not betting advice.

GOLVIVA_API_KEY.description: Personal Golviva API key, created in the account section of https://golviva.com/mcp (shown once, revocable). Only the http-api-key installation uses it; the recommended installation signs in with OAuth instead.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. Your MCP client discovers the OAuth 2.1 metadata and opens golviva.com for a one-time sign-in with Apple or Google; no API key is needed.

http-api-key.description: The same server with a personal API key, for clients that cannot open a sign-in window.

tools.name: get_match_prediction
tools.description: Golviva's prediction for one match, by match id, team (its next match) or league (its upcoming matches): home win, draw and away win chances, the likeliest scores, total goals and both teams to score, the likeliest scorers, the predicted line-ups, corners and cards and, after the final whistle, whether it came in.

tools.name: get_season_projection
tools.description: A league's projected final table: the rest of the season played out 10,000 times, with each club's chance of the title, the top four and the Champions League places, Europe and relegation, and its expected points.

tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: The model's most confident calls of the day (up to 10), locked in every morning before the first kick-off, each with its probability, the likeliest score and scorer, the live or final score and whether it came in, plus the hit rate over the last 7 and 30 days.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: A player's Golviva value next to the market value, the gap and its verdict, the factor breakdown, value history, season stats, transfers, contract and similar players.

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Two to four players side by side: values, age, position, performance percentile, every valuation factor and this season's output.

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Scout by league, club, nation, position, age, preferred foot and value range; sort by value, market value, undervalued, overvalued, youth, performance or recent rise.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Most valuable, most undervalued or overvalued (EUR 10M+), biggest risers or fallers, and wonderkids (21 and under).

tools.name: search_football
tools.description: Find players, clubs, leagues and national teams by name, accents optional.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Every league Golviva values, with its code, strength tier, clubs, players and total squad value.

tools.name: get_league
tools.description: A league's clubs ranked by squad value (Golviva against market) and its most valuable players.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: A club's squad with every player's Golviva value, market value and the gap, plus totals.

tools.name: get_national_team
tools.description: The strongest 26-player squad for a nation (3 GK, 8 DF, 8 MF, 7 FW by value).

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Live scores, results and fixtures (live, today, yesterday, tomorrow or any date) across leagues, European and domestic cups and national-team tournaments.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match in depth: score, event timeline, team statistics, line-ups with ratings and the model's chances.

tools.name: get_team_fixtures
tools.description: A club's or national team's next or most recent matches.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: A competition's table with form and qualification, promotion and relegation zones.

tools.name: get_stat_leaders
tools.description: Season leaderboards (goals, assists, goals plus assists, minutes, appearances) per competition, across national-team competitions, or across all competitions combined.

tools.name: get_transfer_news
tools.description: Latest confirmed transfers and rumours with fees, clubs, reliability and dates.
